thread:
maria-support: Heads-up — HelixHealth's procurement emailed: they will not accept an invoice unless we have an official PO number and a signed SOW on file. They called it a policy requirement, not negotiable.
finance-bot: Proforma created PRO-F-2026-1187 (PDF) — https://invoices.redwood/proforma/PRO-F-2026-1187 :page_facing_up:
alex-sales: Thanks, Maria. Can we ask if a PO draft + email confirmation from their procurement would unblock billing? They said 'no invoice without PO' so sounds strict.
jon-ops: From ops perspective, we can enable access or start a trial but not bill until paperwork is cleared. Any provision that would incur charges needs PO first per finance.
lisa-legal: Quick note — we should not make exceptions that contradict the signed contract. If HelixHealth's PO requirement is in their procurement rules, we can accept PO and invoice against it. We need the SOW signed or an email confirmation referencing the master agreement.
maria-support: They also mentioned their AP system rejects vendor invoices without a numeric PO. They want the PO before the invoice is recorded.
alex-sales: I'm pinging procurement contact now. In the meantime, do we want to send the proforma + a short note explaining the items and quoting the PO field to fill? Could speed things up.
support-manager: Yes — send proforma + one-sheeter with line items and suggested PO format. Finance will need the PO number, billing address, and tax/VAT ID.
finance-bot: FYI required fields: PO number, billing contact email, billing address, VAT/Tax ID (if non-US). Missing fields will delay processing.
lisa-legal: Also confirm tax treatment — if they're EU-based, we need VAT handling info on the PO. Don't add pricing changes in the proforma without sales sign-off.
alex-sales: Draft email and proforma attached. Maria, can you send it to the procurement contact and cc finance@redwood? I'll follow up by phone.
maria-support: Sent the proforma + suggested PO template. Included a short checklist: PO number, contact, VAT ID, signed SOW if needed.
alex-sales: Procurement replied: they will issue a PO but need an invoice date that matches the PO issuance. They asked if we can backdate the invoice — we can't. Told them invoice will be created once PO received.
jon-ops: Operationally that's fine. We'll queue the onboarding steps as pending and kick them once finance confirms invoice created.
support-manager: Keep the customer updated. If they push for immediate access, offer a non-billable trial window and document it. No service activation that incurs charges until PO is on file.
maria-support: Customer agreed to submit the PO by end of week. Closing loop here; will update when PO arrives. :white_check_mark:
